decisions.reason: As a dedicated analytics add-on that builds directly on the firm's market-data and calculation capabilities, it remains a low-cost option with credible cross-selling potential.
This electricity tariff calculator is very close to the core offer and still has strong learning and customer-retention value relative to its likely modest carrying cost.
Because it is a multi-model line with only limited website prominence, risk is higher now, but the platform fit and ability to test variants still justify keeping the option open a bit longer.
The area definition tool complements the firm's broader tariff and regional solutions, so management would usually retain it while monitoring whether it supports bundle sales and platform use.
After another year, this lightly promoted comparison line looks more replaceable and overlapping with adjacent tariff products, so the option value appears too low to justify continued attention.
